candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement crediting msg.value to the sender's balance so deposits are not recorded.
Swap the branches of the unlockTime ternary so a future _unlockTime is rejected and the current timestamp is stored instead.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer logged in the Log contract's History.
Delete the `locked_ = false;` reset so the lock is never released and any subsequent Put call reverts.
Replace `locked_ = true;` with `locked_ = false;` so the guard never actually locks, allowing consecutive/reentrant Put calls that the original would revert.
Delete the balance subtraction after a successful call so Collect never decreases the sender's recorded balance.
Change the balance check from >= to > so withdrawing exactly the full balance is no longer allowed.
Replace the unlockTime check so collection is allowed only before the unlock time instead of after.
Remove the reset of locked_ so after the first Collect the mutex stays locked and all subsequent calls revert.
